uncited: Application-Specific Pipelines adapt the general NeRF training loop to solve domain-specific inverse problems by modifying the neural field architecture, loss functions, and optimization strategy.
**Specialized Neural Field Architectures**: Standard NeRF uses a single MLP mapping $(x, y, z, \theta, \phi) \to (\sigma, c)$.
**Iterative or Multi-Stage Optimization**: Many methods do not optimize a single static field directly.

Originating from the need to apply NeRF beyond static scene reconstruction, these pipelines emerged as researchers sought to integrate NeRF with robotics navigation, remote sensing, and interactive content creation.

Key developments include RehearsalNeRF for dynamic scenes [12477-rehearsalnerf.md], Neural SAR for inverse radar imaging [12668-neural-sar-surface-reconstruction-via-inverse-rendering.md], and GO-NeRF for text-guided 3D editing [11181-go-nerf.md].
